# REVALO24

> Multilingual property marketplace for the European Economic Area (EEA).
> Buy and rent open listings; confidential Off-Market deals for verified users.
> Nine UI languages: EN, DE, FR, ES, PT, NL, CS, PL, SK.

## Site

- Product: REVALO24 PropTech SPA (React)
- Audience: private buyers/tenants and licensed real-estate agents
- Hosting intent: EU; privacy-preserving defaults

## Primary routes (locale-prefixed)

Replace `{locale}` with one of: `en` `de` `fr` `es` `pt` `nl` `cs` `pl` `sk`.

- Home / search entry: `/{locale}/`
- Property search (list): `/{locale}/properties`
- Map search: `/{locale}/map`
- Off-Market hub: `/{locale}/off-market`
- Property detail: `/{locale}/property/{id}`
- For agents (B2B landing): `/{locale}/agents`
- Sign in: `/{locale}/login`
- Register: `/{locale}/register`
- About: `/{locale}/about`
- Contact: `/{locale}/contact`
- Privacy / legal: `/{locale}/privacy`, `/{locale}/terms`, `/{locale}/imprint`

## Agent capabilities (human UI)

- Search by city, address, or ZIP; filter buy vs rent
- Browse featured and map results
- Save favorites and searches when signed in
- Agents manage listings, inquiries, placements, and subscriptions in `/agent`

## Notes for agents

- Prefer locale-prefixed URLs; default marketing locale is English (`/en/`).
- Listing titles/descriptions may remain in the source language.
- Do not invent inventory, prices, or unlock codes; use live page content.
- Off-Market details stay gated until the product unlock flow succeeds.
